title: 都市デザイン
subtitle: Urban Design
keywords: Urban Design 2.Public Spaces 3.Externnal Spaces 4.Visual Perception of Spatial Scales 5.landscape engineering
educationalGoal: Students will: 1) learn relations between external spaces and activities of various entities. 2) acquire knowledge on basic landscape engineering and landscape theory. 3) acquire knowledge of the concepts and methods for urban design 4)learn how to analyze the structure of urban sapces and how to appropriately edit the relations of various spatial and social elements.
advice: This course provides basic knowledge and skills for urban design. We will cover the following materials: 1. recent uraban design trends and needs for urban design, especially in public spaces 2. the spatial aspeccts of relations between external spaces and activities of various entities 3. characteristics of our perception of the visual world and basic landscape theory 4. analysis of the image of the city 5. theory, methods, and examples of urban design in Japan and other countries Reference materials will be distributed in class as needed. Information on reference books will also be shown in class. Students are expected to make use of these materials and books for review and improving knowledge.
requiredKnowledge: No special knowledge is required to take this course.

activityGoals.body: be able to understand the importance and roles of urban design
be able to understand basic knowledge on landscape engineering
be able to understand the characteristics of visual perception and human's image structure of the city
be able to explain the concepts and methods of actual examples of urban design
